scope: Isolated S31 SHA register/block engine; first actual bootloader execution from unchanged official INK4 Plus2.0.68 full image. No product readiness.
sources: sources.json: fixed IDF v6.1 sha_reg.h and esp_hal_security/esp32s31/sha_ll.h; hp_sys_clkrst_reg.h; public20260528 ROM

supported.execution: actual shared compression, synchronous register/block mode
s31Differences: 16-bit DMA count configuration; DMA itself unsupported
4-bit mode decoded with unsupported algorithms rejected rather than aliased
supported.sourceProof: ROM computes digest from source-built Flash image, matches appended bytes, warns for changed digest and rejects changed payload checksum
supported.gates: System/security/SHA clocks plus parent/security/SHA/DS/HMAC/ECDSA resets. Parent/DS/HMAC/ECDSA reset dependencies explicitly in official LL; enclosing security-domain gate follows register grouping and has no independent silicon verification.

notImplemented: Physical crypto timing/security-domain or silicon validation

regressionControls.behavior: ROM calculates original correct digest, warns mismatch, attempts boot anyway and source guest executes
ROM checksum assertion loop; no source guest entry
